title_en: Zu Guijun and Xiang Shucheng — case of theft, robbery of firearms and ammunition, and theft and robbery
keywords_en: criminal; theft; forcible seizure of guns; ammunition; theft; robbery; second instance; High People's Court; Hebei Province; Yunnan Province; Shanxi Province; natural person; criminal law; determination of charges; determination of principal offender; sentencing; affirmation of original judgment; theft of guns; forcible seizure of guns
full_text_en:
Zu Guijun and Xiang Shucheng — theft and snatching of firearms and ammunition, and theft and robbery

Defendant: Zu Guijun, male, 24 years old, from Yunnan Province, farmer. Arrested on June 9, 1995; prior to arrest, he was a temporary worker at Hezhuang Coal Mine in Wu'an City, Hebei Province.

Defendant: Xiang Shucheng, male, 22 years old, from Yunnan Province, farmer. Arrested on June 15, 1995; prior to arrest, he was a temporary worker at Hezhuang Coal Mine in Wu'an City, Hebei Province.

The case of Defendants Zu Guijun and Xiang Shucheng for theft and snatching of firearms and theft and robbery was instituted by the Handan City People's Procuratorate of Hebei Province with the Handan Intermediate People's Court. After public trial, the Handan Intermediate People's Court found as follows:

In the early morning of February 15, 1995, Defendants Zu Guijun and Xiang Shucheng surreptitiously entered the Fujiaying Finance Office of Jiangchuan County, Yunnan Province, stealing over RMB 20 in cash. They then climbed over the wall into the Fujiaying Police Station, pried open the door and entered, stealing one Type 54 pistol, 6 rounds of ammunition, over RMB 200 in cash, a dagger, and an identity card, among other items.

In the early morning of April 30, 1995, Defendants Zu Guijun and Xiang Shucheng, together with co-defendant Luo Zhiqiang (already sentenced), roamed to the Xibaishi Police Station in Wu'an City, Hebei Province. They climbed over the wall and pried open the door, stealing RMB 10 in cash, then entered the office of She Runtian of the same station, stealing one set of police uniform. Discovering a firearm, the three conspired to snatch it. Xiang Shucheng stood lookout outside the room, while Zu Guijun, holding a brick, and Luo Zhiqiang returned inside. Zu Guijun struck the sleeping She Runtian violently on the head with the brick, causing She Runtian minor injury and unconsciousness; Luo Zhiqiang covered She Runtian with a quilt, and they snatched one Type 64 pistol and 10 rounds of ammunition.

In the early morning of March 31, 1995, Defendant Zu Guijun, carrying the stolen Type 54 pistol, together with Defendant Xiang Shucheng and co-defendant Guo Wenkai (already sentenced), went to the home of Shen Manhong in Xibaitucun Village, Suburbs of Changzhi City, Shanxi Province. They broke the door to enter the yard, threw bricks randomly into the house, and forcibly demanded money and property. Shen Manhong shouted for help and Zu Guijun fired a shot into the house; the three then fled, the robbery attempt unsuccessful.

In the early morning of April 24, 1995, Defendants Zu Guijun and Xiang Shucheng went to the staff dormitory building of the Yuquanling Iron Mine of Handan Mining Bureau in Hebei Province. They pried open the door and entered the room of a female worker, Cheng Haiyun. Upon being discovered by Cheng, Zu Guijun threatened her with the Type 54 pistol and snatched a quartz clock, clothes, and other items. From March 1994 to April 1995, Defendant Zu Guijun also committed 8 separate thefts, stealing cash and goods totaling over RMB 19,000 in value. Defendant Xiang Shucheng, together with others, committed 1 robbery, stealing RMB 60 in cash, and committed 6 separate thefts, stealing cash and goods totaling over RMB 6,000 in value.

After the case was solved, one Type 54 pistol, one Type 64 pistol, 13 rounds of ammunition, as well as the quartz clock and clothes were recovered.

The above facts are confirmed by the victims' statements, case reporting materials, crime scene investigation records, trace examination reports, witness testimonies, and the recovered firearms, ammunition, and other stolen items. The defendants' confessions also match the above evidence. The evidence is conclusive and sufficient for determination.

The Handan Intermediate People's Court held that Defendants Zu Guijun and Xiang Shucheng, by stealing a firearm once and using the stolen firearm to commit robbery, and by snatching a firearm once and injuring a police officer during the snatching process, have violated the provisions of Article 112 of the Criminal Law of the PRC, constituting the crimes of theft of a firearm and snatching of a firearm respectively. Their criminal circumstances are especially serious. Pursuant to Article 1(4) of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Regarding the Severe Punishment of Criminals Who Seriously Endanger Public Security, they should be sentenced to a punishment above the maximum penalty prescribed by the Criminal Law, up to and including the death penalty. Zu Guijun and Xiang Shucheng jointly committed robbery twice (one attempt); Xiang Shucheng also jointly with others committed one robbery. Their acts have violated Article 150 of the Criminal Law, constituting the crime of robbery, and their criminal circumstances are serious. As for the attempted robbery, pursuant to Article 20 of the Criminal Law, they may be given a lighter punishment compared to the completed crime. Zu Guijun committed 8 thefts, stealing cash and goods totaling over RMB 19,000; Xiang Shucheng committed 6 thefts, stealing cash and goods totaling over RMB 6,000. Their acts have violated Article 152 of the Criminal Law, constituting the crime of theft, and their criminal circumstances are especially serious. Zu Guijun and Xiang Shucheng jointly stole and snatched firearms and ammunition and committed robbery; pursuant to Article 22 of the Criminal Law, they constitute a joint crime and should be given heavier punishment. Moreover, each committed multiple crimes and should also be subject to cumulative punishment for multiple crimes under Article 64 of the Criminal Law. Accordingly, on May 21, 1996, the Handan Intermediate People's Court ruled as follows:

Defendant Zu Guijun: convicted of snatching a firearm, sentenced to death, deprived of political rights for life; convicted of theft of a firearm, sentenced to death, deprived of political rights for life; convicted of robbery, sentenced to ten years' imprisonment, deprived of political rights for three years; convicted of theft, sentenced to ten years' imprisonment, deprived of political rights for three years. The combined sentence is death, deprivation of political rights for life.

Defendant Xiang Shucheng: convicted of theft of a firearm, sentenced to death, deprived of political rights for life; convicted of snatching a firearm, sentenced to life imprisonment, deprived of political rights for life; convicted of robbery, sentenced to fifteen years' imprisonment, deprived of political rights for five years; convicted of theft, sentenced to seven years' imprisonment, deprived of political rights for one year. The combined sentence is death, deprivation of political rights for life.

After the judgment was pronounced, Defendant Xiang Shucheng refused to accept it, appealing to the Hebei High People's Court on the ground that he was not a principal offender and the sentence was excessive.

After trial, the Hebei High People's Court held that the criminal facts found in the first-instance judgment were clear and the evidence was conclusive. The determination that Defendants Zu Guijun and Appellant Xiang Shucheng committed the crimes of theft and robbery was correct in nature and the sentences were appropriate. However, characterizing Zu Guijun's and Xiang Shucheng's acts of stealing and snatching police firearms and ammunition as the crimes of theft of a firearm and snatching of a firearm respectively was incorrect in nature; they should be characterized as the crime of theft and snatching of firearms and ammunition. Appellant Xiang Shucheng actively participated in the theft and snatching of one handgun each and multiple rounds of ammunition, participated in robbery and multiple thefts, and acted in joint crime with Defendant Zu Guijun. All circumstances were especially serious and warranted severe punishment. His appeal ground that he was not a principal offender and the sentence was excessive was not accepted. Accordingly, on July 16, 1996, the Hebei High People's Court ruled as follows:

Defendant Zu Guijun at first instance: convicted of theft and snatching of firearms and ammunition, sentenced to death, deprived of political rights for life; convicted of robbery, sentenced to ten years' imprisonment, deprived of political rights for three years; convicted of theft, sentenced to ten years' imprisonment, deprived of political rights for three years. The combined sentence is death, deprivation of political rights for life.

Appellant Xiang Shucheng: convicted of theft and snatching of firearms and ammunition, sentenced to death, deprived of political rights for life; convicted of robbery, sentenced to fifteen years' imprisonment, deprived of political rights for five years; convicted of theft, sentenced to seven years' imprisonment, deprived of political rights for one year. The combined sentence is death, deprivation of political rights for life.

The Hebei High People's Court, under the authorization of the Supreme People's Court, approved the criminal judgment imposing the death sentence and deprivation of political rights for life on Zu Guijun and Xiang Shucheng.
